remarks: Welcome to this beautifully designed 1,710 sq. ft. two-storey home in the growing community of Lakeview, built by Art Homes. Perfect for growing families, this home offers 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, including a main floor bedroom and full bathroom, ideal for guests or family living. The open-concept main floor features 9 ft. ceilings, a modern kitchen with a large island, walk-in pantry, The plus point is the side entrance offering future basement development potential. Upstairs, you'll find 9 ft. ceilings, a spacious bonus room, 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, and a convenient laundry room, creating an open and airy living space for the whole family. Complete with a double attached garage, premium finishes, and located close to parks, schools, shopping, and walking trails, this home offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality.
